screens.title: Public · Landing
screens.source: Hand-written design reference (not captured), implemented by frontend/projects/public/src/app/pages/landing/landing.component.ts
screens.note: Public landing page reimagined for Oakridge Women's Neighbourhood Housing Co-operative Inc.: the CMS-driven home page reimagined with a PAL Toronto-style structure (hero, at a glance, who we are, gallery, building and community, what's on, board, quote, visit, footer). Hand-written HTML on its own stylesheet (assets/own-site.css) with light and dark themes; not a capture of the implemented app.
